tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub pa'i thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra samba ra dwa ṣaṣthi de ba sa dha ka nishtsi tāttha tsand+ra pra bha siddhi ra sā ya na nā la/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi sgrub pa'i thabs nges don zla ba'i 'od zer grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab brjid char sprin sngon po'i dpal 'dzin zag med bde ba'i 'od dkar 'phro/ /kun la rjes brtse'i spyan mig dmar ldan ral pa'i phreng ba steng du brdzes/ /byang chub sems kyi zla ba'i cod pan tshad med rang bzhin zhal mnga' zhing / /rten 'brel thugs chud phyag gi yal ga bden gnyis zhabs can gang der 'dud/ /shin tu ches zab 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam/ /rmad byung brgyud pa'i gtso bo sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srol dri med bla ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /thun mong ma yin rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir 'khor lo bde mchog slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje'i lugs bzhin nyams su blang ba la don gsum ste/ sbyin bya dbang bzhi dang / nyams su blang bya rim pa gnyis dang / drod thob nas spyod pas mtshams sbyar te 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mngon du bya ba'o/ /dang po dang phyi ma gnyis ni logs su shes par bya zhing / lam gyi dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis bsgom pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po la gnyis/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshad med bsgom pa/ sems bskyed pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas so/ /dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/

sku gsung thugs kyi lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i brgyab khaṇḍa ro hi'i mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ chos po ti'i rnam pa ni chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du mos la/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyi bdag gis rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems kyis gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon por zhu/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos po ti 'od dmar por zhu/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar por zhu/ dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ rang gi zhal bzhi las/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer spros/ sems can tshad med bzhi la bkod par bsam la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyud dang ldan par gyur sogs spyi ltar ro/ /rje sa chen gyi tshad med bzhi 'dir mi bya zhes pa'i don/

lu hi pa ltar sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pa 'dir mi bya zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sngags kyi sku ru gyur pa yi/ /bdag ni he ru kar byas nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la dgod par bya/ /gsum/ bzhi pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs khar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ /de las 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs yab kyi sku gang rdo rje'i lam brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis ka'i sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā lā ya/ badzra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/ a nu rakto me bha ba/ su po ṣyo me bha ba/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/

sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa badzra he ru ko bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel sgong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la bzhi/ dga' ba gsum dran pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shrī he ru ka3haṃ/ lan gsum/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /don de dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid do/ /rang gi snying gar ā dkar po rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du/ rang gi sems gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i hūm̐ du gsal ba'i zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos dbyings ye shes te ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ hūm̐ de las 'od 'phros rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ gnyis pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar phaiṃ/

badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥshrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍal sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra samba ra maṇḍal sa pa ri wā ra/ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta pra tītstsha swā hā/ phyi mchod do/ /yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gang ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig se gol gcig gtog yang sngar gyi phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ sū ra sū ra/ ā wart+ta ya/ ā wart+ta ya hoḥ na massa mānta/ buddhā nān/ a bisma ye/ spha ra ṇa/ i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu/ a kā sha/ sa mānta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ parṣa dha la/ maṇḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi dha na/ puṇya/ dzñā na/ ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ banda ni/ swasd+ya/ ba le na tsa swā hā/ phyag rgya bkrol la se gol lan gnyis su gtog go /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs yan lag bdun pa spyi 'gro/ lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ gsum pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rang gi sems su shes par byas te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharm+mā swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ sems de yang rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid do/

/oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ bzhi pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems kyi rnam sprul gyis sprul pa'i nam mkhar nā da/ thig le/ zla tshes/ mgo bo/ khog pa/ zhabs kyu/ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'og tu paṃ raṃ hūm̐ rnams chad de/ padma nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las steng dang / shar du khwa gdong ma re re/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma re re/ lhor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gshin rdze brtan ma/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams spros nas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad pa'i las mdzad/ lus kyi lag pa g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub se gol phyogs g.yon skor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du bstan cing / ngag tu oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihṇa pa ya/ gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān bidya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gu dang bla bre/ phyi rol kun tu me'i dra ba dang / ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ me dī ni badzri bha ba bandha hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bī ta na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzā la traṃ saṃ taṃ/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lā rka hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐/ phyag rgya snga ma phyogs kun tu ston cing / sngags rnams re re bzhin tshar gsum re brjod do/ /slar yang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu dang tho ba'i tshogs spros nas pho nya rnams kyi phyag tu gtad cing / pho nya rnams las kyang rang 'dra'i sprul pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag med spros te/

phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad bkug dkar po'i phyogs rnams skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab/ lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur dang / g.yas pa'i sor mo dbus ma gsum gshibs te sgreng / mthe bong gi mthe'u chung mnan pas phur bu brdung pa'i tshul bya zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭaṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya/ kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra kī la ya/ badzra dha ro ā dzñā pa ya ti/ sarba bighnān kā ya wākka tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mutka ra badzra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ pho nya rnams rdo rje ra ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas bsgrubs pa po sangs rgyas kyi bar srung bar mdzad/ sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la gnyis/ tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang / lha'i snang ba'ang ye shes su shes par bya ba'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ baṃ las chu/ raṃ las me/ yaṃ las rlung / de'i steng du suṃ las ri rab thig le ser po dang bcas pa so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams dang rang gi sems snang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa/ gru bzhi/ bang rim bzhi/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las sna tshogs padma nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang pa/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du sngon po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba'i steng du/ rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng / gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas byung ba'i mu tig gi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer kha dang zla ba rlung gi bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang / de'i steng du rin po che'i dra mig seng ma'i pu shus skor ba/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byed pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba'i mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa sman dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gar bu sngon po gru bzhi pa'i steng du mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rim pa gzhir gnas pa'i/

phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po/ /'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ bar ma gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po padmas mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ nang ma thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa/ lte ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ gri gug gis mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub dang bcas pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ dwangs shing gsal la bsgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'phro ba/ lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun po thams cad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsnol ba'i gdan/ 'khor gyi gnas thams cad du ro'i gdan re re dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas pa ni/ shar du drag gtum/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ shar lhor nags tshal/ phun sum tshogs pa/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa/ byang shar du hā hā rgod pa'i dur khrod/ rim pa de bzhin du/ brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/ chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong brgyad dang / shirsha/ a shwattha/ kaṃ ka la/ tsū ta/ ka rañdza/ lā ta parka ti/ parti pa ṭa/ bha ṭa ste shing brgyad dang / de rnams kyi yal ga'i gseb tu sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i drag gtum skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad dang / sgra grag pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil ba/ gang ba 'bab pa/ drag po 'khrigs pa ste sprin brgyad dang / nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/

padma/ hu lunta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong / padma chen po ste klu brgyad dang / gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 'dre dang / srin po dang / ro dang ro langs dang / sha za dang / lce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gnyis/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang bskyed pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i phreng ba lta bu'i/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug dkar po hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po 'od dmar po 'bar zhing 'jigs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yas sngo nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab/ yum dmar mo yin no/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ dang / bu gar byaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' ā las padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa ze'u 'bru la ā dang /

bu gar dhyaṃ gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sngar gyi bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo/ bar snang na gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad mar thig le'i rnams par babs pas/ yab yum gnyis bde ba chen po'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ byang chub sems kyi thig ler gyur/ gnyis pa 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog dang po la bzhi ste/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ go cha bgod pa nye bar sgrub pa/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug sgrub pa/ dbang bskur ba sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis/ oṃ ma hā su kha badzra sa twa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ su ra tasatwaṃ dṛshya hoḥ zhes mgrin gcig tu bskul bas thig le de cha gnyis su gyur/ de las hūm̐ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang aṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yas dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi btsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas bzung bas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ drug pa na gri gug g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ lnga pa na thod pa khrag gi gang ba/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor lcog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches spras shing /

g.yon phyogs na tshes gcig gi zla ba dang / mtshogs ma'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lto ba dang skye gnas brdzis zhing / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltas pa'i gdong pa mnan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yis/ /gar gu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar phyar te 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhal bzhi la dmigs nas/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa zhal/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yon zhal/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyab zhal/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ g.yas zhal lo/ /sku byings la dmigs nas/ oṃ dharm+ma dhā tu swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa nye bar sgrub pa ni/ yab yum gnyis ka'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ yab kyi snying gar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swā hā hu/ dmar po padma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bau ṣaṭa he nag po he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/

tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog dang / yum gyi lte bar oṃ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar oṃ haṃ yoṃ sngon mo/ gshin rje ma/ khar oṃ hrīṃ yoṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar oṃ hreṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug du oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo ste/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ hṛ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dmar po gsung rdo rje/ dpral bar oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la samba raṃ swā hā dkar po sku rdo rje/ yum gyi thugs kar oṃ sarba baddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra ba nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par oṃ badzra tsau ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dmar po gsung rdo rje/ dpral bar oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dkar po sku rdo rje/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par āḥdamar po 'od dpag med/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po mi bskyod pa/ lte bar swā ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/ gnas su hā ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bo'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar skor zhing / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi rnam par phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ arghaṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shaddha sarba dharm+ma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor bdag dang chos thams cad rnam par dag go /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/

slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang / yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar dang / snying po gnyis kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la bzhi/ bha gar dkyil 'khor bskyed pa/ dkyil 'khor spros te nang dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab pa/ pho nya rnam gsum bsres nas byin gyis rlabs pa/ go cha bgod cing byin gyi brlabs pa bzhi las/ dang po ni yab yum gyi mkha' gsang sngar ltar byin gyis rlabs/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ dga' ba'i sgra dang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis bskul bas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal nas zhugs/ thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs/ yab kyi thig le dang yum gyi rakta ro gcig tu 'dres pa las byung ba'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan/ phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha bzhi bcu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa ni/

dbus kyi thig le bcom ldan 'das yab yum/ gzhan rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thod pa thugs/ gsung sku'i lha/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams su gyur/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor spros te nang dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab pa la gnyis/ gzhi 'god pa dang / spro ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gsal ba'i snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma brgyad pa nyis brtseg du gnas pa'i lte bar hūm̐/ nang skor gyi phyogs bzhir g.yon skor du/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi/ phyi skor 'dab ma brgyad la/ hūm̐ brgyad/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su khams dang rtsa rnams/ u/ a/ go ra/ de/ la/ ka o/ tri/ ko ka la/ ka hi/ pre/ gṛ/ sau/ su/ na/ si/ ma/ gru'i rnam pa can no/ /gnyis pa spro ba dngos ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te/ 'og rlung bskyod pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs snying kha'i rnam par shes pa'i rten khams dpa' bo hūm̐ gi rnam par gnas pa la thim pas nang gi he ru kar gyur pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ ces pa nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces pa'i bar 'bras bu rdor 'dzin ltar gsal btab/ mkha' nang nas drangs pa phyir spros te phyi'i he ru ka la thim/ mkha' nang gi rdo rje phag mo rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ rang gi lte ba'i aṃ la reg pas byin gyi rlabs/ yar drangs snying ga'i phyi shun gyi rtsa hūm̐ gi dbyibs can la thim pas nang gi he ru ka'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ yar drangs pa phyir spros nas phyi'i yum la thim/ mkha' nang gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga'i nang skor gyi phyogs kyi 'dab ma'i yig 'bru rnams la reg pas nang gi rnal 'byor ma bzhir gyur/ yar byon pa rnams phyir spros nas phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir 'khod pa ni nang dang phyi'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/

byang du lā ma ljang skya/ nub tu khaṇḍa ro hi dmar skya/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i tshul dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i nang du glang po che dang / lce spyang dang / mi dang / ba lang rnams 'dzin pa/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs/ g.yas bskums pa'i stabs kyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga'i mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi la reg yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir 'khod pa ni/ nang dang phyi'i mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi mtshan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi thugs gsung sku'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams rim pa bzhin rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas so sor reg pas gnas rnams yul dang / khams rnams dpa' bo dang / rtsa rnams rnal 'byor ma rnams su gyur/ yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros gzhal yas khang gi gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ nang gi spyi bo'i so dang sen mo'i khams dang rtsa pu'i rnam pa can dang / phyi'i thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs/ pu li ra ma yar khaṇḍa ka pā la dang / rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug gi skra dang ba spu'i khams dang rtsa dza'i rnam pa can dang / byang rtsibs dza landha rar/ mahā kaṅkal dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas su lpags pa dang dri ma'i khams dang rtsa au'i rnam pa can dang / nub rtsibs au ḍi ya nar kaṅkal dang 'od ldan ma ltag par sha'i khams dang rtsa a'i rnam pa can dang / lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnar gtsigs pa dang / sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon par chu rgyus kyi khams dang rtsa go'i rnam pa can dang /

shar lho'i rtsibs go dā wa rir su ra bī ri dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus su rus pa'i khams dang rtsa ra'i rnam pa can dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs ra me shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis su mchin pa'i khams dang rtsa de'i rnam pa can dang / nub byang gi rtsibs de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis su snying gi khams dang rtsa ma'i rnam pa can dang / byang shar gyi rtsibs mngal bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog sngon po/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ mchan khung gnyis su mig gi khams dang rtsa ka'i rnam pa can dang / gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs ka ma rū par aṅgu ri dang / ai ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis su mkhris pa'i khams dang rtsa o'i rnam pa can dang / byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing / lto bar glo ba'i khams dang rtsa tri'i rnam pa can dang / nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma sna rtser rgyu ma'i khams dang rtsa ko'i rnam pa can dang / lho rtsibs ko la sar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing / khar snye ma'i khams dang rtsa ka'i rnam pa can dang / shar lho'i rtsibs ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang shya ma de bī/ mgrin par lto ba'i khams dang rtsa la'i rnam pa can dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs lampa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tstshandho hā/ snying gar dri chen gyi khams dang rtsa ka'i rnam pa can dang / nub byang gi rtsibs kañtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'doms bar du mtshog ma'i khams dang rtsa hi'i rnam pa can dang / byang shar gyi rtsibs hi mā la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na ste nye ba'i tstshandho hā ste gsung gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ mtshan mar bad kan gyi khams dang rtsa sre'i rnam pa can dang / sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam du rnag gi khams dang rtsa gṛ'-i rnam pa can dang / byang rtsibs gṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang / khaṇḍa ro hā ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis su khrag gi khams dang rtsa so so'i rnam pa can dang / nub rtsibs so sor raṣṭar rta mgrin dang shauṇḍi nī/ byin pa gnyis su rngul gyi khams dang rtsa su'i rnam pa can dang / lho rtsibs su barṇa dwi par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug du tshil gyi khams dang rtsa na'i rnam pa can dang / shar lho'i rtsibs na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis su mchi ma'i khams dang rtsa si'i rnam pa can dang / lho nub kyi rtsibs sindhur padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/ mthe bong bzhir mchil ma'i khams dang rtsa ma'i rnam pa can dang / nub byang gi rtsibs ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis su snabs kyi khams dang rtsa ku'i rnam pa can dang / byang shar gyi rtsibs ku 'du ltar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod/ sku'i 'khor lo'i lha rnams kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ khaṇṭa ka pā li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcu'i bzhi'i do shal dang / stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pas dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa/

rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i dpa' mo rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang / zhabs g.yon brkyangs/ g.yas bskums pas yab la 'khyud cing / gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa ba 'dab brgyad kyi hūm̐ la reg pas nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur/ yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros te phyi'i dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod pa ni nang dang phyi'i shar sgor kha gdong ma sngo skya/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser skya/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar te 'dzin zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lnga dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thams can/ drag mo shin tu khros pa'i tshul can/ nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyangs/ g.yas bskums pas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so so rnams su reg pas/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsibs logs rdo rje'i ra ba/ lpags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/

ba spu mda'i dra ba/ skra sen me ri 'bar ba ste srung ba'i 'khor lo dang / rkang mthil rlung / sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ rgal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu ga bzhi sgo bzhi/ mig pañtsa re kha/ sna rin chen pha gu so dra ba dra phyed/ lce mchu 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rna ba rta babs/ rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad de rten gyi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi bu ga dgu ni dur khrod brgyad rnams su gyur/ yar drangs pa rnams phyir spros nas/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ gsum pa pho nya rnam gsum bsres nas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag gi bsgom pa'i sngags skyes phyi nang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid ni/ phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes kyi sprul pa'i sku rnams yin la/ de yang 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams yin zhing / de thams cad dbyer med pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin no/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba wī ra yo gi ni kā ya wākka tsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ lan gsum/ bdag gi bsgom pa'i sngags skyes kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi zhing skyes dang / 'og min gyi lhan skyes rnams dbyer mi phyed pa rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa'o/ /oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharm+ma badzra shuddho3haṃ/ bzhi pa go cha bgod cing byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du go cha gnyis gong bzhin 'god do/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog la bzhi ste/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bya ba/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa/ phyi dang nang gi mchod pas mchod cing bstod pa/

dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag dran pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad/ phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong tshogs zhing ltar phyi dang yid byung gi mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharm+ma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor gyi ngo bor chos thams cad rnam par dag la/ bdag kyang de'i ngo bor rnam par dag go /sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod cing lag pas pad skor 'khyud rgya gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas btab pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin phyi dang yid byung gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ shrī tsakra bī ra satwaṃ/ kā kā sye/ ū lū ka sye/ shwa nā sye/ sū ka ra sye/ ya ma dā ḍhī ye/ ya ma dū tī ye/ ya ma daṃṣṭ+ri ṇye/ ya ma ma tha nī ye/ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing phyi nang gi lha rnams la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ lā mā la don yod grub pa/ khaṇḍa ro hi la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gzhan 'khor lo bzhi'i shar phyogs pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ byang phyogs pa rnams la don yod grub pa/ nub phyogs pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ lho phyogs pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ shar lho ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ lho nub pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/

nub byang pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ byang shar ba rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ gsum pa phyi nang gi mchod bstod bya ba la drug sngags mchod/ phyi/ nang / gsang ba/ yid byung / bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ go cha gnyis rnams 'og bzlas pa'i skabs ltar la/ ma mo bcu gnyis la spel med par tshar re re bzlas so/ /gnyis pa phyi'i mchod pa ni/ mchod rdzas dngos su bsham pa'am/ yid kyi bsams nas/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pa mang po sprul nas lha thams cad la mchod pa phul bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sambha ra maṇṭa la sarba bī ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin gzhan rnams la yang sbyar nas 'bul lo/ /gsum pa nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ bdud rtsi dngos su yod dam/ med na bsam ste/ 'og gtor ma'i skabs bzhin byin gyis brlab la lag g.yon mtheb srin gyis g.yon skor du chos 'byung bri zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rgyas par na yab yum gyi snying po nye snying / 'khor rnams kyi sngags phreng ltar ram/ bsdu na/ hūm̐/ baṃ/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ pu dza sogs dang / hūm̐ brgyad/ go cha gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hri ha ha huṃ huṃ phaṭa/ lnga dang / lag pas rnam lnga 'dod skor dang 'khyud rgya bya'o/ /bzhi pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta ba dzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3/ lnga pa yid mchod ni gong ltar bya'o/ /drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ gtor ma'i skabs bzhin bya ste/ mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor kyi rnam dag dran pa ni/ rgyas pa byed na/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa ni mā mā'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa ni khaṇṭa ro ha'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni khaṇṭa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni ma hā kaṅkal dang gtum pa'i mig can ma spyod pa'i rdzu 'khrul gyi rkang pa ni kaṅkal dang 'od ldan ma/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ dad pa'i dbang po ni su ra bī ra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po ni rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni aṅku ri dang ai ra ba ti/ dad pa'i stobs ni rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ dran pa'i stobs ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni rab tu bzang po dang shyā ma de bī/

shes rab kyi stobs ni rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni mig mi bzang dang kha ga na/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rin po che rdo rje dang khaṇṭa ro hā/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta mgrin dang / shauṇḍi nī/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i rtsol pa ni khyi gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma/ dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /zhes brjod/ bsdu na bdag gi blo la snang ba'i phyi nang gi lha sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang / lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo rnam par dag go /rgyun gyi nyams len la bsdus pa 'dis chog cing /

skabs su rgyas pa bya'o/ /bskyed rim la sems 'dzin na gtso bo'i spyi gtsug gi nor bu dang / zhabs kyi sen mo res 'jog du byed do/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan zin to/ ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ ba santa tī la ka ltar na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer spros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du gyur pa rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gi bsgom pa'i gzhal yas khang dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gi lus dkyil gyi gnas so so rnams su thim/ bcud kyi sems can 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam par byas pa rnams 'od du zhu ba 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba/ rlung dang bstun nas khwa gdong ma nas mkha' 'gro ma'i bar shar phyogs pa rnams rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ 'ug gdong ma nas lā mā'i bar byang phyogs pa rnams sna bug g.yas nas thim/ khyi gdong ma nas khaṇḍa ro ha'i bar nub phyogs pa rnams g.yon nas thim/ phag gdong ma nas gzugs can ma'i bar lho phyogs pa rnams g.yas nas thim/ gshin rje brtan ma nas mtshams kyi thod pa'i bar shar lho pa rnams g.yon nas thim/ de bzhin du lho nub pa rnams g.yas nas thim/ nub byang pa rnams g.yon nas thim/ byang shar ba rnams g.yas nas thim/ yum yang 'od dmar por zhu nas lte ba'i aṃ la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim pas/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i snying gar hūm̐ sngo skya/ lte bar oṃ dmar po shad kyi rnam pa can la cung zad sems gtad/ der rjes rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ lte ba nas snying ga'i bar la rtsa a wa dhū ti kha dog dmar skya drang zhing gsal ba/ g.yas su rā sa na dmar po me'i rang bzhin/ g.yon du lā la na dkar po chu'i rang bzhin/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i dbus su aṃ/

nang bskor 'dab ma brgyad la/ a/ ka tsa/ ṭa/ ta/ pa/ ya/ sha phyi skor lnga bcu rtsa drug la yi ge med pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūm̐/ 'dab ma brgyad la phyogs bzhir bhrūṃ aṃ dzrīṃ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir aṃ maṃ saṃ taṃ/ sum mdor me/ bshang sgor rlung / 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas/ tha ma la bsdams pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ /sum mdo'i me sbar bas lte ba'i aṃ 'bar/ me lce g.yas ro ma nas song / snying ga'i hūm̐ la phog pas de las byang chub kyi sems dkar po g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ aṃ la phog pas me sngar bas cher 'bar ba dbu ma nas yar song / hūm̐ la phog yang de las byang sems dkar po cher babs pa/ dbu ma nas thur du song ba lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam nas 'bar 'dzag skra bshad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad cing / rlung bum pa can 'dzin no/ /de lta bu'i rlung sbyor gsum tsam ci rigs byas rjes rig pa stong gsal/ nam mkha' lta bu la mnyam par gzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste lam gyi dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bstan zin to/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor la gsum/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang gi snying ga nas rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa spros te/ sngar bzhin gsal bar gnas pa'i/ rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal nas zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ padma nas rang gi gsang gnas nas byung ste/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim zhing / yang sngar bzhin 'khor/ sngags phreng ni/ rgyun ma la kha dog sngon po 'od dkar po 'phro ba/ sngags gcig gi mjug la gcig gi mgo gtad nas/ mda'i shugs kyi 'jug pa zhes bya/ bsnyen pa'i tshe/ sngags sngon po 'od dmar po 'phro bas lha dbang du sdud pa/ sngags snga ma'i mjug lcags kyu ltar gug pa la phyi ma'i mgo yang de lta bus sbrel ba lcags sgrog 'gros zhes bya/

gnyis ka la sngags phreng phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'od 'phros nas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal btab/ nang du 'jug pa'i dus bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas rang la thim pas gzi brjid rgyas par bsam/ bzlas phreng ni/ a bhi dha na las/ lag g.yon mthe bong srin mdzub kyis/ dung chen phreng ba rab blangs nas/ zhes gsungs ba ltar/ phreng ba rab mi'i thod pa'i phreng ba'am/ yang na nā ri ke la/ zhes pa mi mo'i thod pa ste/ be ta'i phreng ba lag pa g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyi steng du de nyid kyi mthe bong ches 'gugs pa'i tshul du bzlas la/ sngags bzlas rgyu ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma la zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang / rang rang gi mtshan sngags gnyis med du spel ba/ 'khor lo gsum la yab yum gnyis med/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yab kyi rkang brgyad mtshan sngags gnyis med/ go cha gnyis rnams so/ /de yang rgyun du gtso bo'i snying po nye snying gang mos gtso bor mang ba/ gzhan rnams kyang cha tshang re bzlas/ bsnyen pa'i tshe gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po nye snying la 'bum phrag bzhi re/ 'khor rnams la de'i bcu cha khri phrag bzhir re/ go cha gnyis rab gtso bor dang grangs mnyam/ tha na'ang 'khor rnams dang mnyam par bzlas/ sngags dngos ni logs su bris pa ltar dag par 'don no/ /bzlas pa bsdu na phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas brtan byed kyi yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod la/ bdag bskyed 'brel bar gtor ma 'bul na mtshams 'dir 'das gtor dang /

chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin phul rjes/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba gong bzhin la/ gtso bo yab yum mi bsdu bar/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i steng du/ snying gar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po sogs dpa' bo'i go cha dang dpa' mo'i go cha gong bzhin dang / go cha chen po ni/ pu dza sogs nas/ ma ku'i bar ngag du brjod/ sems kyi lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yab yum nas sgo mtshams ma'i bar yig 'brur gyur par bsam mo/ /tsham rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba ni/ gong srung 'khor skabs bzhin/ lag g.yon sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur ston cing / ngag tu oṃ sumbha sogs tshar gnyis brjod dus/ sems kyi phyogs g.yon skor dang / mtshams g.yas skor du zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kha dog sngon po/ /'od zer dmar ser 'bar ba'o/ /steng 'og g.yon g.yas snol mar bya/ dga' ba gsum dran pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku'i rnam pa/ yi ge bdun pa tshar gcig brjod nas/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad 'khor lo bde mchog gi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /dge rtsa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs dang / srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan/ /he ru ka dpal de dang bsngags pa lhan cig gar byed shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /de'i gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i/ /he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ /shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i/

/bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /gnyis pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ /gtor ma gsum mam gnyis la sogs pa gang rung lag len ltar bsham/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sumbha sogs kyi bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa'i steng du/ ā las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su go las ba glang gi sha shar du ku las khyi'i sha byang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las rta'i sha lhor na las mi'i sha de rnams re re'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ dbus su bi las dri chen/ shar du mu las dri chu/ byang du shu las byang sems/ nub tu ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rakta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ chos dbyings ye shes/ shar du bhrūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dzrīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ lhor oṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dbus su byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po rtse mo 'og tu bstan pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'og tu song bas rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du skyod pas/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba kha ṭwāṃ ga rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam par byung nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim/ steng gi oṃ dang zla ba kha ṭwāṃ ga rnams kyang 'od du zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas/

kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrī/ gsum brjod/ gtor mgron ni/ bdag bskyed 'brel na/ bdag bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad dang / mdun bskyed dang 'brel na/ de'i dur khrod brgyad dang / gnyis ka dang ma 'brel bar zur du 'bul na/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ gtso bo yab yum/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma thugs gsung sku'i lha tshogs/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dur khrod brgyad la phog pas dkyil 'khor cha brgyad du gyur/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas sngags skyes/ zhing skyes/ lhan skyes kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gis dkyil 'khor thams cad/ phaiṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor cha dgur gyur/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ oṃ badzra a ra li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ḍri shya ho/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni kha kha khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ ma ma karya/ sā dha ya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pheṃ/ pheṃ/ pheṃ/ swā hā/ lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ rgyas par lha sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gcig brjod pas kyang 'bul bar bshad do/ /bsdus na ka ra ka ra sogs dpa' bo nyer bzhi'i sngags tshar gcig brjod/ de nas mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo ste phyi/ sa bon so so'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ na mo sogs yid mchod/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kalpāgni sanni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭotka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṣṭ+raṃ kā lo gro bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho dya ta shu la kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ri ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā grā dzi nāmba ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā dhuṃ brāndha kā ra ba su ṣāya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab kyi'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badzra bā ra hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ārya a pa rā dzi te trai le kya ma hā bi dye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma sarba bhu ta bha ya bā/ hya mahā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā ji te bā shyaṅka ri ne tra bhra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dha ni ka rā li ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na massaṃ trā sa ni/ mā ra ṇi/ su pra bhe da ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye/ dzambha ni/ stambha ni/ mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badzra bā ra hi ma hā yo gi nī/ kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ /yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa'o/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa bcom zhing yang dag rtog pa 'joms/ /khyed kyi dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ /mgon po thugs rje'i char gyi yang dag brlan pa'i thugs kyi chus/ /lha mo rnams kyi bdag la shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab la/ de nas gur zhal/ las mgon/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs gang dgos gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin btang ngo / /yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ bdag bskyed dang 'brel bar gtor ma phul ba yin na/ 'das pa'i mgron ni bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa nyid kyi chog pas/ gong ltar bsdu/ mdun bskyed 'brel ba'am/ gzhan du bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs byed/ med na rang la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rnams kyang phal cher de dang mtshungs/ de rjes dge rtsa bsngo ba bkra shis sogs gong du bshad pa bzhin rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ro/

/gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ gsum pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la lnga ste/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnyid log pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal ba rang yab yum la bsdu/ yum yang yab la/ de snying ga'i hūm̐ la/ de'i zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar stong pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ /gnyis pa ldang ba na nam mkha'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ḍa ma ru'i sgra ka ra ka ra la sogs pa dang / yi ge bdun pa'i sgrar grags pas bslang ste/ skad cig gis he ru ka yab yum zhal phyag rdzogs par lang ngo / /de'i thugs kha'i 'od kyis snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar dran par byas la/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sogs brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /gsum pa khrus byed pa'i tshe nam mkhar dbang lha sngar bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i chus rang gi lus la blugs pas sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chag dag par bsam zhing / yi ge brgya pa brjod pas bkru'o/ /bzhi pa kha zas ni gtor ma ltar byin rlabs byed pa'am/ bsdu na lag pa g.yon pas kha zas btung ba sogs la reg cing / 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur pa/ rang phyi'i he ru ka'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar bas lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs gsal btab pa'i/ nang gi gtso bo he ru ka'i spyi bor bla ma rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa dang / lto bar chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam zhing longs spyod/ lhag ma oṃ u tsiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣa si swā hā/ zhes lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ lnga pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba gzhan la 'jug pa'i tshe gong du bshad pa ltar/ tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba'i nang du bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor dang /

de yang rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug tu shes pa'i ngang nas chos kyi bshad nyan gtor ma chos spyod kha ton la sogs pa dge ba'i bya ba kho na la rtag 'grus su byas na myur du shrī he ru ka'i go 'phang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di dag gi mtha' dpyod pa dang / rnam par gzhag pa rgyas pa ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i gsung rab tshad mar gyur pa rnams dang man ngag shes pa'i bla ma las mnyan nas khong du chud par byos shig dpal ldan gsang chen rgyud sde'i rgya mtsho gnam sngon bzhu ba lta bu'i dbus/ /dpal gyi 'od 'bar sgo drug rtser son gsang mtha'i nor bu dri med ni/ /dpal chen nā ro'i man ngag rgyal mtshan rtse mor gsal bar bkod pa gang / /dpal ldan pha na phing gu mal gyo dag las rim par brgyud pa'o/ /sa skya'i rje btsun snying po'i zhabs dang rtse mo rgyal mtshan paṇa chen sogs/ /nges don gnas lugs ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mkhas grub zhal gyi bdud rtsi can/ /legs pa'i 'byung gnas gang gi bka' drin cher thob gzhan yang 'khor lo'i mgon/ /buddha'i mtshan can la sogs yongs 'dzin mchog gi byin rlabs 'di brtsams so/ /deng sang snyigs dus grags pa'i rjes 'brang nas/ /man ngag zab dgu dag la nan tan bral/ /cung zad shes kyang ne tso'i 'don pa bzhin/ /snying po med pa'i tshig la lhur len mang / /de bas nges don gdams pa sna tshogs nyon/ /nyams len byed tshe snying po'i don la dril/ /gtad med tshe 'di'i bya gzhag rtswa ltar dor/ /bslu med bla ma'i bdud rtsi snying la bstim/ /byang chub sems gnyis brtson pa'i lcag btab nas/ /bde chen mkha' spyod gnas su rab bgrod pa'i/ /zab mo'i lam 'di yang yang bsgom byas na/ /myur du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal thob 'gyur/ /'di brtsams dge ba kha ba dung dang kunda lta bur ches dkar de yi mthus/ /kun gsal mtha' klas rigs drug skye dgu sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying zhing nub pa rnams/
